description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA Linux driver, including PCIe endpoint private data, MSI modes, and related functions.

classes.name: dc_ep_priv
classes.description: Structure holding private data for PCIe endpoint, including PCI device info, memory addresses, MSI configuration, bonding peers, and associated ACA data.

classes.name: dc_ep_info
classes.description: Structure containing overall endpoint info, including device number, MSI mode, and array of endpoint private data.

classes.name: pcie_ep_adapter
classes.description: Structure for card-specific private data, including platform device for the MEI driver.

methods.name: to_aca
methods.description: Inline function converting dc_ep_priv pointer to associated dc_aca pointer.

methods.name: dc_aca_shutdown
methods.description: Function to shut down the ACA component for a given endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_info_init
methods.description: Initialize ACA info for a given endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_start
methods.description: Start ACA operation on a specified function for an endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_stop
methods.description: Stop ACA operation on a specified function for an endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_init
methods.description: Initialize ACA with parameters for an endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_event_addr_get
methods.description: Retrieve ACA event register addresses for an endpoint.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_sub_ack
methods.description: Send a sub-acknowledgment for ACA TX input.

methods.name: aca_umt_msg_addr
methods.description: Get UMT message address for ACA.

methods.name: dc_aca_txin_hd_cnt
methods.description: Get count of HD entries in ACA TX input.

methods.name: dc_aca_free_fw_file
methods.description: Free firmware file resources associated with ACA.
